Create a match, share one link — players join with name, position, and a self-rating, and FairXI auto-generates fair teams (snake-draft by skill) and splits the pitch cost per player. After the match, everyone votes MVP and gets a running stats history over time. Vote on the contest page: https://app.emergent.sh/showcase/fabrizio/6680af4f-dd3e-4eb2-b083-47f7338fe5b4

records.name: ardlex
records.tagline: Transform English words into cartoons to aid memorization.
records.description: It generates comics in an anime style. Compared to the simple cartoons found in other English learning apps, these comics are more vivid and expressive, making it easier to convey the meanings of words. Furthermore, each comic is accompanied by an AI-generated short story.

records.name: SongKeyPad
records.tagline: Local Windows tool that finds BPM, key and chord changes.
records.description: SongKeyPad combines BPM, musical key and timestamped chord detection in one private Windows app. Unlike web-first tools, analysis happens entirely on your PC—no uploads, accounts, networking or in-app analytics. Its editable chord timeline lets you correct results, adjust boundaries and export to text, CSV or JSON. It also supports microphone analysis for quickly checking live passages. And, it adapts its theme to the music! Cute.

records.name: InterviewCopilot
records.tagline: Job interview assistant that works seamlessly.
records.description: Get real-time interview assistance, structured answers, and contextual notes in a private desktop app. Works with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

records.name: E-Invoicing Solution For UAE Mandate
records.tagline: CherrieBS provides UAE E-invoicing intergration for ERPs.
records.description: Manage your tax compliance right inside your current ERP dashboard. Cherrie Business Solutions is an expert E-invoicing services company delivering flawless E-invoicing integration with Dynamics 365. Our certified consultants connect your Business Central or Finance and Operations platform directly to the Federal Tax Authority reporting network. We automate the complex XML mapping and live buyer validation instantly. Save this pin and tap the link to future proof your accounting system.

records.name: ProfitSearcher
records.tagline: Discover high-growth SaaS before they go mainstream
records.description: ProfitSearcher turns noisy software-market data into actionable founder intelligence. It tracks breakout SaaS and App products, revenue and traffic signals, pricing changes, and unmet user needs, then publishes concise signals and deep-dive reports to help founders decide what to build.

records.name: Allbuyzone
records.tagline: Professional Forex & Multi-Asset Risk Matrix Terminal
records.description: Allbuyzone is a professional-grade risk calculator for Forex, Gold, Crypto, and multi-asset trading. Calculate margin, pip value, and hedging grids with institutional precision. Start your 7-day free trial. Bypass rigid fixed calculations. Allbuyzone is a high-performance computational utility interface for advanced multi-asset derivatives portfolios. It calculates live broker margin locking rules, elastic pip metrics, and grid layers with zero latency

records.name: Pixie
records.tagline: Your AI agent that works, researches, and gets things done
records.description: Pixie is a privacy-focused AI agent for automation, outreach, and productivity. Research companies and prospects, create personalized cold emails, send mass emails, and track Gmail outreach. Students can use their skills and experience to research companies and reach out to HRs for internships and jobs. Pixie also helps you work with files, Excel, documents, and everyday tasks—all while making powerful automation more accessible and affordable.

records.name: Instagram Reels Safe Zone Checker
records.tagline: Preview Instagram Reels safe zones before posting
records.description: Instagram reel safe zone explained: exact dimensions, why captions get cut off, and how to keep every element visible before you post.

records.name: Face Shape Detector
records.tagline: Discover your real face shape in seconds measured by AI.
records.description: Most people guess their face shape from a mirror or a random online quiz, but StarDoppel's Face Shape Detector replaces guesswork with actual measurement. The AI maps dozens of facial landmarks forehead width, cheekbone position, jaw angle, and total face length and classifies your face into one of six categories: oval, round, square, heart, diamond, or oblong. Along with your shape, you get personalized hairstyle, makeup, and eyewear recommendations tailored to your specific structure.

records.name: AiLotteryPredictor
records.tagline: Real data. Real models. Honest predictions.
records.description: AI-powered lottery predictions for Powerball, Mega Millions & Millionaire for Life using 24 machine learning models. Real data. Honest predictions.

records.name: EasyToolHub
records.tagline: 21+ Free Online Tools in 8 Languages. No Sign-up, No Ads.
records.description: EasyToolHub is a privacy-first collection of 21+ free online tools — BMI calculator, currency converter with live rates, password generator, loan calculator, unit converter, and more. Everything runs in your browser, zero data collection. What makes it different: 🌍 8 languages with fully localized content 🔒 All calculations happen on your device 📱 Works on any device, supports dark mode 📝 16 in-depth tech reviews with comparison tables 🆓 Free forever, no sign-up required

records.name: SiraPay
records.tagline: Your Money. Your Privacy. Your Freedom.
records.description: SiraPay is a privacy-first virtual card platform supporting 150M+ merchants worldwide with 150+ country coverage. Trusted by users across 51 countries, it offers no forced KYC, affordable pricing, and card creation for global payments. Users can pay for subscriptions, ads, and online services easily with secure, fast, and flexible payment solutions.

records.name: VisoDyne Battery Monitor
records.tagline: Live battery % for every wireless device, in your tray
records.description: All-in-one battery monitor for Windows: Bluetooth, 2.4GHz, AirPods, controllers, mice, and keyboards. Live tray icons per device, custom alerts, full customization.

records.name: SubZerofree
records.tagline: Remove video captions & edit PDFs free-right in your browser
records.description: SubZero is two free browser tools in one: remove captions/subtitles from videos, and a full PDF toolkit — merge, split, rotate, compress, watermark, extract pages, images→PDF, PDF→JPG, and more. Everything runs 100% locally in your browser (video via ffmpeg.wasm, PDFs via pdf-lib/pdf.js) — your files never get uploaded, no signup, no watermark on output. Also bilingual (English/Arabic, full RTL support

records.name: SaveTube - Video Downloader
records.tagline: Save videos from your favorite social platforms
records.description: SaveTube is a fast, free social media downloader that lets you save public videos and reels from multiple platforms in high quality. No signup, no hassle.

records.name: ProCalcTools
records.tagline: Finance Health Productivity
records.description: 66+ free calculators built for Americans — no sign-up, no ads, instant results. 💰 Finance: Mortgage, retirement, 401(k), compound interest, paycheck, overtime, debt payoff, net worth, Roth IRA 🩺 Health: BMI, TDEE, calories, macros, body fat, sleep cycles, water intake, pregnancy due date 🧮 Utility: Grade, GPA, tip, sales tax, square footage, age, discount Uses official IRS, CDC & FLSA formulas. Works as a PWA — installs like an app.

records.name: Warpdrive
records.tagline: Open-source alternative to Pipedrive
records.description: Warpdrive is an open-source, self-hosted Pipedrive alternative for business-development teams: pipeline management, a deal workspace, contacts, and two-way Gmail, running entirely on your own infrastructure.

records.name: Re-QR Invoice Validator- KSA
records.tagline: Offline Invoice QR Validation for Professionals.
records.description: Re-QR: Invoice QR Validator is a privacy-first, offline tool for validating invoice QR codes, UBL 2.1 XML files, and PDF/A-3 e-invoices. Scan QR codes, inspect invoice data, and calculate VAT—all directly on your device with no cloud uploads. Designed for businesses, accountants, auditors, and developers. Re-QR is an independent application and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ZATCA or any government authority.

records.name: NoteitHub
records.tagline: Convert text to todos, and knowledge graphs that persist.
records.description: Noteithub gives ChatGPT persistent memory for productivity. Anything a user plans or discusses in ChatGPT — tasks, goals, journal entries, knowledge graphs — is saved automatically and stays available across every conversation, on a web dashboard, and via Notion export. Instead of losing action items when a chat ends, users get goal-organized todo lists with smart deduplication, one-command conversation journaling, and visual knowledge graphs, all created without leaving ChatGPT.

records.name: Slate Scripts — screenwriting Git style
records.tagline: Git-style drafts for screenwriters. No AI, local & cloud.
records.description: Version a rewrite, compare it word-by-word, merge what works, lose what doesn't. Scripts live on your Mac as plain text — no accounts, no telemetry, no AI. The tool is there to help you do your best work and collaborate with others to make something amazing. You own everything and nothing lives on the cloud, unless you want it to) Import from your other writing tool (Final Draft, Celtix, etc) $79/yr after a 30-day free trial, no credit card needed. Cancel anytime.

records.name: Shastra - Turn websites into mobile apps
records.tagline: Your website deserves to be an app. Shastra makes it happen.
records.description: Shastra converts any website into an app - WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Webflow, or custom. One-time payment. All future updates included. What's different about Shastra: → Works with any website or CMS → Push notifications, custom branding, flexible navigation → Direct Slack access to the founder for publishing support → No monthly fees, ever We built Shastra because we got tired of watching clients pay recurring fees for something that should be a one-time build.

records.name: AnyTimerApp
records.tagline: Make your friend chug a beer whenever you want
records.description: Won a bet? Great. You’ve earned yourself an Anytimer. Now your friend has to chug a beer whenever you want. Or a seltzer. Or eat a mango. It all depends on what kind of person you are. Anytimers are a way to keep score when making bets without involving money. Want one of your friends to eat a mango at midnight? Great. Ever heard of an “any mango”? You can make it as crazy as you please.

records.name: Locker
records.tagline: The all-in-one workspace for students.
records.description: Homework, projects, groups, and achievements — the all-in-one workspace built for students.

records.name: SteadyMaps
records.tagline: Self-hostable Google Maps alternative for business websites
records.description: SteadyMaps is a self-hosted Google Maps alternative for business location pages. Show your location without third-party map requests or recurring API fees.

records.name: Rewisp
records.tagline: See it once. Ask forever.
records.description: Rewisp gives your Mac a memory. It reads your screen text on-device and remembers it for you. Catches promises like "I'll send it Friday" and reminds you until it's done. Ask "what changed since Tuesday?" and see exactly what's new. Search by meaning, not just words. Tracks numbers like weight or grades over time. Fills forms from your saved details — never passwords. One quiet 9 PM summary each day. Fully private: screenshots never saved, only text stays on your Mac.
